name: Scratchpad Frame
author: AktOn1
description: A frame around the scratchpad (SUPER + S) that slides in and out with it. Twenty smooth styles (Omarchy, Cyberpunk, Aurora, HUD, Terminal, Glass, Foliage, Sacred, Kawaii, Celestial, Vaporwave, Sakura, Deep Sea, Steampunk, Frost, Halloween, Cosmic, Megacity, Gilded, Pasteup) plus four 16-bit pixel-art styles. Pick from a centered menu; optionally recolour every style from your Omarchy theme and hide the title.
